rules.title: No Single Bar Prediction
rules.description: NEVER call a directional reversal from a single bar. Wait minimum 2 consecutive bars confirming the new direction.

rules.title: CVD Extremes = Exhaustion
rules.description: A CVD spike >2x prior ATH in one bar is EXHAUSTION, not continuation. Same for crashes >2x max 1-bar decline. Flag as exhaustion; do NOT call continuation.

rules.title: No Invented Probabilities
rules.description: Probabilities must come from validated hit-rate. No backtest = output 'probability: unvalidated'. Every probability claim must cite a rule from rules.json.

rules.title: Score, Don't Predict
rules.description: Output a structured signal scorecard (0-100). Bias >= 60 bullish, <= 40 bearish, 40-59 neutral. Bias is the weighted sum of all signals, not a gut call.

rules.title: No Pattern Anchoring
rules.description: Past shakeouts do not predict future shakeouts. Each bar is judged on its own data. Do not reference prior bar patterns as evidence. Only use current bar data + structural levels.

rules.title: Distribution Threshold
rules.description: ALL required: (a) CVD drops 2+ consecutive bars AND (b) footprint shows 4+ levels with >70% bid-side selling AND (c) DOM imbalance below +5%. Only then output bearish bias.

rules.title: Accumulation Threshold
rules.description: ALL required: (a) CVD rises 2+ consecutive bars AND (b) footprint shows 3+ levels with >70% ask-side buying AND (c) DOM imbalance > +10%. Only then output bullish bias.

rules.title: Audit On Loss
rules.description: After a call that fails (price moves >1% against within 2 bars), record loss with root cause in audit.log.json at START of next analysis.

changelog: 3.4.1 (2026-10-07): Parameter adjustments for Rules 2, 6, 7. spike_multiple 2.0->1.5, dom_imbalance_max 5->3, dom_imbalance_min 10->8, footprint thresholds 70->65, dom_persistence_polls_min 3->2. Enhanced sensitivity without changing rule structure.
